name: Clomacran

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom, first in 1982 — for liver harm

similar.name: Clomipramine
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for mental health effects

similar.name: Clozapine
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for blood problems, heart harm and blood vessel problems

summary: Clomacran was removed from the market in the United Kingdom in 1982 because it caused liver harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave it a low score for liver concerns and a high score for heart concerns [M]. A related drug, Clomipramine, has a strong boxed warning in the United States for mental health effects [4]. Another similar drug, Clozapine, has a boxed warning in the United States for blood issues, heart damage, and blood vessel problems [5].
